high_level_description: This image captures a moment at the 2008 Met Gala in New York, themed "Superheroes: Fashion and Fantasy." The setting is a red carpet event, with photographers and onlookers in the background, indicating a high-profile and glamorous occasion. In the foreground, two individuals stand side by side on the red carpet. The person on the left is dressed in a classic black tuxedo with a white shirt and black bow tie, exuding a formal and elegant appearance. The person on the right is wearing an elaborate white lace gown with intricate detailing and a high slit, paired with silver strappy heels.
